name: Spill Agent Docs With AgentPlaybook Workflow
hardRules: Every feature unit must pass a necessity check before implementation
Agents must classify unknowns through the shared AgentPlaybook ambiguity gate before PRD authoring
Agents must ask the maintainer when blocker unknowns remain unresolved
Every non-trivial feature must pass PRD and ARD gates before implementation
App startup, lifecycle, packaging, and status item changes must run runtime smoke verification
Parallel code-edit tasks must have disjoint write scopes
Feature run files must not contain unresolved template placeholders
Repository docs, task artifacts, comments, and scripts must be written in English
